resources.description: The Youth Academy Residential School will be a proactive, learner-centered, research-based, outcome -oriented educational and Residential program, built on a foundation focused collectively on respect, restraint, and responsibility. The program is designed to give 100 (at-risk) young men (eventually 200), in grades 6,7,8 (and 6 – 12 eventually) the opportunity to learn about themselves and their community ; acquire knowledge and skills (Florida Standards) necessary for access to meaningful post-secondary opportunities in a highly competitive growing economy ; and provide youth with opportunities and support to build positive lives, enhanced by development of interpersonal skills that include a focus on basic critical thinking and conflict resolution , to enable them to move into contributing roles in society. The program will help youth develop, achieve, and maintain a lifestyle free from substance abuse and crime, through a Residential school environment.

resources.description:
Lubee Bat Conservancy is an international nonprofit organization dedicated to saving bats and their habitats through conservation, education and awareness, with a focus on children and community engagement.

Lubee places animal care, conservation, and education as its three core institutional purposes. Animal welfare is held to the highest standards, ensuring the collection receives the best care in line with modern zoological practices and philosophies. Our local and global conservation and education programs connect children with nature, foster environmental stewardship, and inspire the next generation of conservation scientists to become leaders within their communities.

resources.accessibility_notes: The directory does not currently provide structured physical-access fields. Confirm the features you need.
resources.hours: Hours listed for Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; confirm before traveling.
resources.description:
Sunrise Wildlife Rehabilitations mission is to assist injured, orphaned or displaced native wildlife and support their finders/rescuers. SWR is qualified, committed and compassionate with release, into suitable habitat as the ultimate goal. We offer guidance for co-existence with our wild neighbors and participate in conservation efforts. 

We regularly conduct off-site interpretive wildlife programs with non-releasable native wildlife ambassadors, in order to enlighten an instill a respect, understanding and a deeper appreciation for wildlife, nature and the environment.

We serve High Springs, Florida and neighboring communities. SWR has a designated , easy to navigate emergency help-page on our web-site- WWW.sunrisewildlife.org. which helps out of area rescuers to find a qualified wildlife rehabilitator in their area. We get many out of area calls and quickly assist rescuers and wildlife.We have a collaboration of qualified sub permittes/ rehabilitation facilities. This network allows us efficiency to assist rescuers with many wildlife situations.
